English: The effective management of odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) remains a subject of interest and confusion in the Oral and Maxillofacial surgery literature.
Luganda: Enzijanjaba etuukiridde eya odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) ekyaliko ebibuuzo era ekyabuzaabuza mu biwandiiko bya Oral and Maxillofacial surgery.
Yoruba: Àmójútótó múná dóko ti odọntojẹ́ní kẹratósíìsì (OKC) jẹ́ kókó-ọ̀rọ̀ ìnífẹ̀sí àti ìdojúrú nínú ìwé àkọsílẹ̀ iṣẹ́ abẹ Ẹnu àti Ìtún-ojú-ṣẹ̀dá.
Zulu: Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwe-odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) kuhlala kuyindaba enentshisekelo nokudideka emibhalweni yokuhlinzwa yomlomo kanye ne-Maxillofacial.
Hausa: Gudanarwa mai tasiri na raunin muƙamuƙi (OKC) ya kasance batun sha'awa da ruɗani a cikin wallafe-wallafen tiyata na Baki da Abin da ya Shafi Muƙamuki.
Northern Sotho: Kalafo ya maleba ya odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) ke hlogopoledišano ye e gogago šedi ka mehla ebile e bakago tlhakatlhakano go dingwalo tša mabapi le karo ye e dirwago Leganong le Sefahlogong.
Amharic: የኦዶንቶጄኒክ ኬራቶሲስት(ኦ.ኬ.ሲ) ውጤታማ ቁጥጥር በአፍ እና በመንጋጋ ቀዶ ጥገና የምርምር ጽሁፍ ውስጥ ቀልብን እንደያዘ እና የግራ መጋባት ምንጭ እንደሆነ ቀጥሏል።

English: Currently, there is a lack of consensus regarding the most appropriate treatment for patients with odontogenic keratocyst.
Luganda: Mu kiseera kino, tewali kukkaanya ku nzijanjaba esinga obulungi ey’abalwadde ba odontogenic keratocyst.
Yoruba: Lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ báyìí, kò sí àjọgbà nípa ìtójú tí ó dára jù fún àwọn aláìsàn odọntojẹ́ní kẹratósíìsì.
Zulu: Njengamanje, kukhona ukuntuleka kokuvumelana mayelana nokwelashwa okufanele kakhulu kweziguli ezine-odontogenic keratocyst.
Hausa: A halin yanzu, akwai rashin daidaituwa game da magani mafi dacewa ga marasa lafiya masu fama da raunin muƙamuƙi.
Northern Sotho: Gabjale, ga go na tumelelano mabapi le kalafo ye e tlogago e le maleba go balwetši ba odontogenic keratocyst.
Amharic: በአሁኑ ጊዜ ኦዶንቶጄኒክ ኬራቶሲስት ላለባቸው ታካሚዎች እጅግ ተስማሚው ህክምና ምን እንደሆነ መግባባት የለም።

English: Of the various treatment options available, no modality to date has been shown to demonstrate a zero-or near zero recurrence rates except wide resection with clear margins.
Luganda: Ku nzijanjaba ennyingi eziriwo, tewali nzijanjaba n’okutuusa leero eyaalagiddwa ng’eziyiriza ddala oba nga kyenkana eziyiriza ddala okuddamu kw’obulwadde okuggyako okusalamu ebitundu ebigonvu ebitaliiko butaffaali bwa kookolo kungulu.
Yoruba: Nínú àwọn oríṣiríṣi àwọn àṣàyàn ìtọ́jú tí ó wà, kò sí ìlànà kankan títí di òní tí ó ti ṣàfihàn pé iye àtúnṣẹlẹ̀ rẹ̀ jé òdo tàbí kí ó súnmọ́ òdo àyààfi ìbu-ẹran-dí-ọgbẹ́ tó pọ̀ pẹ̀lú ààlà tó gùn.
Zulu: Ezinhlotsheni ezihlukahlukene zokwelapha ezitholakalayo, ayikho indlela kuze kube manje ekhonjisiwe ukubonisa izinga lokuphinda libe uziro noma eduze neqanda ngaphandle kokukhishwa kabusha okubanzi okunamamajini acacile.
Hausa: Daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan jiyya daban-daban da ake da su, babu wani tsari zuwa yau da aka nuna domin nuna sifili-ko kusa da sifili na yawan sake aukuwa sai faɗaɗɗe tare da bayyanannun iyakoki.
Northern Sotho: Go dikgetho tša go fapafapana tša kalafo tšeo di lego gona, go fihla gabjale ga go mokgwa wo o bontšhitšego go laetša dikelo tša go ipušeletša ga lefeela-goba kgauswi le lefeela ntle le go segwa ga tlhalenama ka bophara moo ntho ka moka e tlošitšwego.
Amharic: ካሉት የተለያዩ የህክምና አማራጮች ውስጥ እስከዛሬ ግልጽ የሆነ ህዳግ ካለው ሰፊ ቆረጣ በስተቀር ያለ ማንኛውም ስልት ዜሮ ወይም ወደ ዜሮ የሚጠጋ የድግግሞሽ ምጥነትን ያሳያል ።

English: With the prevailing dearth of evidence based surgical protocols for the management of patients with odontogenic keratocyst in the literature, this study aims to present a surgical algorithm, based on meta-analysis results, that hopefully will be beneficial in enhancing treatment of patients with this condition.
Luganda: Olw’ebbula ly’ennongoosa ezeesigamiziddwa ku bukakafu mu kujjanjaba abalwadde ba odontogenic keratocyst mu biwandiiko, okunoonyereza kuno kugenderera okulaba amateeka g’omu kulongoosa, ageesigamiziddwa ku bivudde mu kwekenneenya kw’okunoonyereza kw’ekinnasaayansi, nga kusuubirwa okuyamba mu kulongoosa enzijanjaba abalwadde b’endwadde eno.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú àìsí ẹ̀rí lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ fún àwọn ìlànà iṣẹ́ abẹ fún àmójútó àwọn aláìsan tí wọ́n ni odọntojẹ́ní kẹratósíìsí nínú ìwé àkọsílẹ̀ náà, iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí gbèrò láti ṣàgbéjáde ìlànà ìṣirò iṣẹ́-abẹ, nípa àwọn èsì ìtúpalẹ̀-aṣàkójọ-onírúnrú, tí ìrètí wà pé yóò ṣe àǹfààní fún ìtọ́jú àwọn aláìsàn tí ó ní ìṣòro yìí.
Zulu: Ngokuntuleka okukhona kobufakazi obusekelwe ebufakazini bokuhlinzwa okulawulwa kweziguli ezine-odontogenic keratocyst ezincwadini, lolu cwaningo luhlose ukwethula i-algorithm yokuhlinzwa, ngokusekelwe emiphumeleni yokuhlaziywa kwe-meta, ngethemba ukuthi izoba nenzuzo ekuthuthukiseni ukwelashwa kweziguli ezinalesi simo.
Hausa: Tare da ƙarancin shaidar da take tattare da ƙa’idojin tiyata domin kula da marasa lafiya masu fama da raunin muƙamuƙi a cikin wallafe-wallafen, wannan binciken yana nufin gabatar da hanyoyi na tiyata, dangane da sakamakon nazarin bincike-binciken baya, wanda da fatan zai zama mai amfani wajen inganta maganin marasa lafiya masu fama da wannan cuta.
Northern Sotho: Ka diphrothokholo tša karo tša bohlatse bja tlhokego ye e lego gona tša taolo ya balwetši ba odontogenic keratocyst ka dingwalong, dinyakišišo tše di nepile go fana ka tshepedišo ya go dira karo, go theilwe go dipoelo tša tshekatsheko ye kgolo, tšeo go lebeletšego gore di tla ba mohola go maatlafatšeng kalafo ya balwetši bao ba nago le bolwetši bjo.
Amharic: በምርምር ጽሁፎች ውስጥ የኦዶንቶጄኒክ ኬራቶሲስት ታካሚዎችን ለማስተዳደር ካለው በማስረጃ የተደገፉ የቀዶ ጥገና ፕሮቶኮሎች ትልቅ እጥረት ጋር ይህ ጥናት በሜታ ትንተና ውጤቶች ላይ የተመሰረተ የቀዶ ጥገና ስልተ ቀመርን ለማቅረብ ያልማል፤ ይህም ከዚህ ሁኔታ ጋር ያሉትን ታካሚዎች ህክምና ለማሻሻል ጠቃሚ ይሆናል የሚል ተስፋ አለ።

English: Using parameters of; size, lesion type (primary or secondary), syndromic or solitary nature of the lesion, presence of cortical perforations, and locularity; we present a decision tree, to aid treatment planning and help attain the least chance of recurrence in the management of the odontogenic keratocyst.
Luganda: Nga tukozesa ebisinziirwako omuli; obunene, ekika ky’obuvune (obusooka oba obuddirira), obuvune obulaga obubonero obw’enjawulo oba obw’omulundi ogumu, okubaawo ebituli by’okungulu, n’ebitundutundu; tulaga omuti gw’ebisalibwawo, okuyambako mu kuteekateeka n’okuyamba okulaba nga waliwo omukisa mutono nnyo ogw’obulwadde okuddamu mu kujjanjaba odontogenic keratocyst.
Yoruba: Lílo àwọn òsùwọ̀n; ìwọ̀n, irú ọgbẹ́ (àkọ́kọ́ tàbí èyí tí ó padà ṣẹlẹ̀), àwọn àmì tàbí àmì tí ojú ọgbẹ́ ń fi hàn, ifarahàn ihò lọ́wọ́ ìta àti ídúrólẹ́yọ-ẹyọ; a ṣè àfihàn àtẹ èrò, láti ṣe ìrànlọ́wọ́ fún ìṣètò ìtọ́jú àti ìrànlọ́wọ́ láti ní àǹfààní tí ó kẹ́ré jùlọ lórí ìsọdọ̀tun nínú àmójútó odọntojẹ́ní kẹratósíìsí.
Zulu: Ukusebenzisa amapharamitha we; usayizi, uhlobo lwesilonda (esiyinhloko noma sesibili), isimo se-syndromic noma sodwa sesilonda, ukuba khona kwe-cortical perforations, kanye ne-locularity; sethula isihlahla sesinqumo, ukusiza ukuhlela ukwelashwa nokusiza ekutholeni ithuba elincane lokuphindaphinda ekuphathweni kwe-odontogenic keratocyst.
Hausa: Ta amfani da sigogi na; girma, nau'in rauni (na farko ko na biyu) da syndromic ko yanayin kaɗaici na rauni da kasancewar ɓangarorin abin da ya shafi rufin ƙwaƙwalwa na ta waje da rarrabawa; muna gabatar da bishiyar yanke shawara, domin taimakawa shirye-shiryen magani da kuma taimakawa wajen samun mafi ƙarancin damar sake dawowa a cikin kulawa da raunin muƙamuƙi.
Northern Sotho: Ka go šomiša dintlha tša; bogolo, mohuta wa ntho (ya motheo goba ya tlaleletšo), tlhamego ya sebopego sa sinteromo goba sa mohuta wa ntho ya go itlhaola, khwetšagalo ya go epega ga legata, le go keka ga ntho legateng; re fana ka dintlha tše di ka go thušago go tšea sephetho, go thuša peakanyo ya kalafo le go thuša go fihlelela sebaka se sennyanenyane sa go ipušeletša ga taolo ya odontogenic keratocyst.
Amharic: በኦዶንቶጄኒክ ኬራቶሲስት ቁጥጥር ውስጥ የህክምናን እቅድ ለማገዝ እና በድጋሚ ተመልሶ የሚከሰትበትን አጋጣሚ ለመቀነስ፣ የቁስሉን አይነት(መጀመሪያ ወይም ሁለተኛ ደረጃ)፣ ልኩን፣ የቁስሉን ድምረ ህመማዊነት ወይም የብቻነት ተፈጥሮ፣የውጫዊ ሽፋን ሽንቁር እና የክፍልፋይ መኖርን፣ መለኪያዎችን በመጠቀም የውሳኔ ዛፍ የሚባለውን ሶፍትዌር አቅርበናል።

English: By taking together results from existing studies, researchers defined clear steps that doctors could follow to identify and treat patients who have a jaw disease called ‘odontogenic karatocyst’ (OKC).
Luganda: Nga bageraageranya ebyava mu kunoonyereza okwakolebwa edda, abanoonyereza baalaga emitendera emirambulukufu abasawo gye basobola okugoberera okuzuula n’okujjanjaba abalwadde abalina obulwadde bw’emba obuyitibwa ‘odontogenic karatocyst’ (OKC).
Yoruba: Nípa mímú àwọn àbájáde papọ̀ láti inú àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí tí ó ti wà nílẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀, àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣàlàyé àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ tí ó hàn gbangba tí àwọn dókítà lè tẹ̀lé láti ṣe ìdámọ̀ àti láti tọ́jú àwọn aláìsàn tí ó ní ààrun àgbọ̀n tí à ń pẹ̀ ní ‘odọntojẹ́ní kẹratósíìsí’ (OKC).
Zulu: Ngokuthatha ndawonye imiphumela evela ezifundweni ezikhona, abacwaningi bachaza izinyathelo ezicacile odokotela abangazilandela ukuze bakhombe futhi belaphe iziguli ezinesifo somhlathi esibizwa nge-‘odontogenic karatocyst’ (OKC).
Hausa: Ta hanyar tattara sakamako daga binciken da aka gudanar, masu binciken sun bayyana cikakkun matakai da likitoci za su iya bi domin ganowa da kuma kula da marasa lafiya da ke da ciwon muƙamuƙi wanda ake kira 'odontogenic karatocyst' (OKC).
Northern Sotho: Ka go šomiša le dipoelo go tšwa dinyakišišong tše di lego gona, banyakišiši ba hlathollotše magato a maleba ao dingaka di ka a latelago go lemoga le go alafa balwetši bao ba nago le bolwetši bja mohlagare bjo bo bitšwago ‘odontogenic karatocyst’ (OKC).
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች የነባር ጥናቶችን ውጤት በአንድ ላይ በማሰባሰብ ኦዶንቶጄኒክ ኬራቶሲስት(ኦ.ኬ.ሲ) የተባለ የመንጋጋ በሽታ ያለባቸውን ታማሚዎች ለመለየት እና ለማከም ዶክተሮች ሊከተሉ የሚገቧቸውን ግልጽ እርምጃዎች አስቀምጠዋል።

English: An OKC is a lesion, or an unusual growth, on a person’s jaw.
Luganda: OKC buba buvune, oba ekizimba ekitali kya bulijjo, ku luba lw’omuntu.
Yoruba: OKC jẹ́ ọgbẹ́, tàbí ara wíwú àbaàdì, ní àgbọ̀n ènìyàn.
Zulu: I-OKC iyisilonda, noma ukukhula okungavamile, emhlathini womuntu.
Hausa: OKC wani rauni ne, ko girma mai ban mamaki, a kan muƙamuƙin mutum.
Northern Sotho: OKC ke ntho, goba kgolo ye e sa tlwaelegago, mohlagareng wa motho.
Amharic: ኦ.ኬ.ሲ በሰው መንጋጋ ላይ ያለ ቁስል ወይም ያልተለመደ እድገት ነው።

English: Doctors find the condition difficult to treat, and patients often develop another OKC even after successful treatment.
Luganda: Abasawo bakaluubirirwa okujjanjaba ekizibu kino, era abalwadde batera okufuna OKC ne bwe baba nga babadde bajjanjabiddwa bulungi.
Yoruba: Ó máa ń nira fún àwọn dókítà láti tọ́jú, àwọn aláìsàn sì tún máa ń ni OKC mìíràn lẹ́yìn ìgbà tí a bá ti ṣe àṣeyọrí lórí ìtọ́jú ọ̀kan.
Zulu: Odokotela bakuthola kunzima ukwelapha lesi simo, futhi iziguli zivame ukuthuthukisa enye i-OKC ngisho nangemva kokwelashwa okuphumelelayo.
Hausa: Likitoci suna shan wahalar magance raunin, kuma sau da yawa marasa lafiya sukan sake kamuwa da wani OKC koda bayan nasarar magani.
Northern Sotho: Dingaka di hwetša bolwetši bjo bo le boima go bo alafa, gomme gantši balwetši ba ba le OKC ye nngwe le ka morago ga kalafo ya katlego.
Amharic: ዶክተሮች ሁኔታውን ለማከም አስቸጋሪ ሆኖ አግኝተውታል አብዛኛውን ጊዜም ታካሚዎች ከተሳካ ህክምና በኋላም እንኳ ሌላ ኦ.ኬ.ሲ ያዳብራሉ።

English: Doctors are thus looking for ways to effectively and permanently heal these jaw lesions.
Luganda: Noolwekyo, abasawo banoonya engeri ezituukiridde ez’okujjanjaba n'okuwonyeza ddala obuvune bw'emba buno.
Yoruba: Àwọn dókíta,̀ nítorí náa,̀ ń wá àwọn ọ̀nà tí yóò ṣiṣẹ́ láti lè ṣe ìwòsàn àwọn ọgbẹ́ àgbọ̀n wọ̀nyìí pátápátá.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke odokotela bafuna izindlela zokuphulukisa ngempumelelo futhi unomphela lezi zilonda zomhlathi.
Hausa: Domin haka, likitoci suna neman hanyoyin da za a bi domin warkar da waɗannan raunukan muƙamuƙi cikin inganci da kuma dindindin.
Northern Sotho: Ka fao dingaka di nyakana le ditsela tša go fodiša ka tshwanelo le sa ruri dintho tše tša mohlagareng.
Amharic: ስለዚህ ዶክተሮች እነዚህን የመንጋጋ ቁስሎችን በብቃት እና በቋሚነት ለመፈወስ መንገዶችን እየፈለጉ ነው።

English: In this study, researchers looked for the key steps doctors should take to identify and treat the disease.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baanoonya emitendera emikulu abasawo gye balina okuyitamu okuzuula n’okujjanjaba obulwadde buno.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí wá àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ tí ó jẹ́ kókó tí àwọn dókítà yẹ kí wọn ó gbẹ́ láti lè ṣe ìdámọ̀ àti láti tọ́jú ààrùn náà.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babheke izinyathelo ezibalulekile okufanele bazithathe odokotela ukuze bahlonze futhi belaphe lesi sifo.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun nemi mahimman matakan da ya kamata likitoci su bi domin ganowa da kuma magance cutar.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba lebeletše magato a bohlokwa ao dingaka di swanetšego go a tšea go lemoga le go alafa bolwetši.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች በሽታውን ለመለየት እና ለማከም ዶክተሮች ሊወስዱ የሚገቧቸውን ቁልፍ እርምጃዎች ፈልገዋል።

English: They did this by searching through existing literature, or scientific articles, about OKC.
Luganda: Kino baakikola nga batunula mu biwandiiko ebiriwo, oba atiko z’ekinnasaayansi, ezikwata ku OKC.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe èyí nípa wíwo inú àwọn ìwé àkọsílẹ̀ tí ó ti wà nílẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀, tàbí àwọn ìwé àpilẹ̀kọ ajẹmọ́ sáyẹ́ǹsì, nípa OKC.
Zulu: Lokhu bakwenze ngokusesha izincwadi ezikhona, noma izihloko zesayensi, mayelana ne-OKC.
Hausa: Sun yi hakan ne ta hanyar binciken ayyukan da aka yi, ko maƙalolin kimiyya game da OKC.
Northern Sotho: Ba dirile se ka go phuruphutša go dingwalo tše di lego gona, goba diathikhele tša mahlale, mabapi le OKC.
Amharic: ይህንንም ያደረጉት ስለ ኦ.ኬ.ሲ የተጻፉትን ነባር ጽሁፎች ወይም ሳይንሳዊ መጣጥፎች በመመርመር ነው።

English: They were specifically looking for information on how doctors managed OKC over a period of 1 year, as reported in the 46 articles they found.
Luganda: Okusingira ddala baali banoonya obubaka obukwata ku ngeri abasawo gye bajjanjabamu OKC okumala ekiseera kya mwaka 1, nga bwe bweyolekera mu atiko 46 ze baazuula.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ń kanlẹ̀ wá àlàyé nípa bí àwọn dókítà ṣe ń ṣe àmójútó OKC láàrin ọdún 1, gẹ́gẹ́ bí wọ́n ṣe jábọ̀ rẹ̀ nínú àwọn ìwé àpilẹ̀kọ 46 tí wọ́n ṣàwárí.
Zulu: Babefuna ngokukhethekile ulwazi mayelana nendlela odokotela abaphatha ngayo i-OKC esikhathini esingangonyaka ongu-1, njengoba kubikwe ezihlokweni ze-46 abazithola.
Hausa: Suna neman bayanai na musamman a kan yadda likitoci suka kula OKC a cikin tsawon shekara 1, kamar yadda aka ruwaito a cikin maƙaloli guda 46 da suka samu.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba tloga ba nyakana le tshedimošo ya ka moo dingaka di laotšego OKC mo pakeng ya ngwaga o 1, bjalo ka ge go begilwe go dingwalo tše 46 tšeo ba di hweditšego.
Amharic: ካገኟቸው 46 መጣጥፎች ላይ በተለይ ዶክተሮች ኦ.ኬ.ሲን ከ1አመት በላይ ለሚሆን ጊዜ እንዴት እንደተቆጣጠሩት የተዘገበውን መረጃ ፈልገው ነበር።

English: The researchers found that OKC was more common in males than females, and could affect people up to the age of 90, even though it was common between ages 20 and 30.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakizuula nti OKC yali nnyo mu basajja okusinga mu bakazi, era asobola okukwata abantu okutuuka ku b’emyaka 90, newankubadde nga yali nnyo mu b’emyaka 20 ku 30.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí rí I pé OKC wọ́pọ̀ láàrin àwọn akọ ju àwọn abo lọ, ó sì lè kọlu ènìyàn títí di ọjọ́ orí 90, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé láàrin ọjọ́ orí 20 àti 30 ni ó ti wọ́pọ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi i-OKC yayivame kakhulu kwabesilisa kunabesifazane, futhi ingathinta abantu kuze kube yiminyaka engu-90, nakuba yayivamile phakathi kweminyaka engu-20 ne-30.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa OKC ya fi yawa a cikin maza fiye da mata, kuma yana iya shafar mutane har zuwa shekaru 90, duk da cewa yana da yawa a tsakanin masu shekaru 20 zuwa 30.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše gore bolwetši bja OKC bo be bo tlwaelegile kudu go banna go feta go basadi, le gona bo ka swara batho go fihla ka mengwaga ye 90, le ge bo be bo tlwaelegile magareng ga mengwaga ye 20 le 30.
Amharic: ኦ.ኬ.ሲ ከሴቶች በበለጠ በወንዶች ላይ የሚከሰት መሆኑን እና ምንም እንኳ በ20 እና በ30 አመት እድሜዎች መካከል የተለመደ ቢሆንም እስከ 90 አመት እድሜ ያላቸውን ሰዎች ሊያጠቃ እንደሚችል ተመራማሪዎች ደርሰውበታል።

English: The disease affected mostly the lower jaw.
Luganda: Obulwadde buno bwasinga kukosa luba lwa wansi.
Yoruba: Àgbọ̀n ìsàlẹ̀ ni ààrùn yìí máa ń kọlù jùlọ.
Zulu: Lesi sifo sithinta kakhulu umhlathi ongezansi.
Hausa: Cutar takan shafi yawancin muƙamuƙi na ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Bolwetši bo amile kudu mohlagare wa ka fase.
Amharic: በሽታው በአብዛኛው የሚያጠቃው የታችኛውን መንጋጋ ነው።

English: OKC starts from inside the bone, with swelling of the jaw only visible later.
Luganda: OKC atandikira mu ggumba munda, ng’oluba okuzimba kirabika luvannyuma.
Yoruba: Láti inú egungun ni OKC ti máa ń bẹ̀rẹ̀, lẹ́yìn ìgbà náà ni àgbọ̀n híhú yóò fara hàn.
Zulu: I-OKC iqala ngaphakathi kwethambo, nokuvuvukala komhlathi kubonakala kamuva.
Hausa: OKC yana farawa ne daga cikin ƙashi, tare da kumburin muƙamuƙi kawai daga baya.
Northern Sotho: OKC e thoma ka gare ga lerapo, moo go ruruga ga mohlagare go lemogwago ka moragonyana.
Amharic: ኦ.ኬ.ሲ የሚጀምረው ከአጥንት ውስጥ ሲሆን ወደ በኋላ ላይ የሚታይ የመንጋጋ እብጠትን ያስከትላል ።

English: Patients usually felt pain and had some discharge (fluid, like pus, that leaks from a wound or lesion), and the roots of their teeth may move out of place.
Luganda: Abalwadde batera okuwulira obulumi era bavaamu amazzi (agalinga amasira, agatonnya okuva mu kiwundu), n’emirandira gy’amannyo gaabwe giyinza okuva mu kifo kyagyo.
Yoruba: Àwọn aláìsàn máa ń jẹ ìrora wọ́n sì máa tú ètútú bi (omi, ọyún, tí ó máa ń jáde láti ojú egbò tàbí ojú ọgbẹ́), ìṣàlẹ̀ eyín wọn lè wọ́ kúrò ní ibi tí ó wà.
Zulu: Iziguli ngokuvamile zazizwa ubuhlungu futhi ziphuma uketshezi oluthile (uketshezi, njengobomvu, oluvuza esilondeni noma esilonda), futhi izimpande zamazinyo zingase zisuke endaweni.
Hausa: Marasa lafiya yawanci suna jin zafi kuma suna samun ɗan ruwa (ruwa, kamar mugunya, wadda take fitowa daga ciwon ko rauni), kuma tushen haƙoransu suna iya matsawa daga wurin.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši gantši ba be ba e kwa bohloko ebile ba etšwa meetsana (seela, se bjalo ka boladu, bjo bo elago go tšwa sešong goba nthong), ebile medu ya meno a bona e ka šutha.
Amharic: ታካሚዎች በአብዛኛው የህመም ስሜት እና አንዳንድ ፍስሳት ( እንደ መግል ያሉ ፈሳሾች ከተጎዳው ወይም ከቁስሉ የሚያዡ )ይኖራቸዋል እንዲሁም የጥርሶቻቸው ስሮች ከቦታቸው ሊወጡ ይችላሉ።

English: They recommended that doctors remove the entire lesion and nearby teeth.
Luganda: Baateesa nti abasawo baggyeyo ekiwundu kyonna n’amannyo agaliraanyeewo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n dá a lábàá pé kí àwọn dókítà yọ gbogbo ọgbẹ́ àti àwọn ẹyín itòsí kúrò.
Zulu: Batusa ukuthi odokotela basuse sonke isilonda namazinyo aseduze.
Hausa: Sun bayar da shawarar cewa likitoci su cire gabaɗaya raunin da haƙori na kusa.
Northern Sotho: Ba šišintše gore dingaka di tloše ntho ya bona ka moka le meno a kgauswi.
Amharic: ዶክተሮች ሁሉንም ቁስል እና በቅርቡ ያሉትን ጥርሶች እንዲያስወግዱ መክረዋል።

English: Once removed, they should apply a medicine called Carnoy’s solution, together with liquid nitrogen (a very cold liquid used to quickly remove damaged skin) and fluorouracil (also known as 5FU, a common cancer medicine).
Luganda: Bwe biggyibwayo, balina okussaawo eddagala eriyitibwa Carnoy’s solution, awamu ne nitrogen ow’amazzi (amazzi agannyogoga ennyo agakozesebwa okuggyawo olususu olulwadde) ne fluorouracil (era amanyiddwa nga 5FU, eddagala erikozesebwa ennyo mu kujjanjaba kookolo).
Yoruba: Ní kété tí a bá ti yọ ọ́ kúrò, kí wọ́n fi oògùn kan tí wọ́n pè ní ẹ̀pa Carnoy si i, papọ̣̀ mọ́ nítírójíìnì olómi (omi tó tutù gan-an tí a máa ń lò láti bó àwọ̣̀ ara tí ó bá ti kú) àti fúróráàsì (tí a tún mọ̀ sí 5FU, oògun jẹjẹrẹ tí ó wọ́pọ̣̀).
Zulu: Uma sebekhishiwe, kufanele bafake umuthi obizwa ngeCarnoy’s solution, kanye ne-nitrogen ewuketshezi (uketshezi olubanda kakhulu olusetshenziselwa ukususa ngokushesha isikhumba esilimele) kanye ne-fluorouracil (eyaziwa nangokuthi i-5FU, umuthi ovamile womdlavuza).
Hausa: Da zarar an cire su, sai su yi amfani da wani magani mai suna maganin Carnoy, tare da ruwa mai sanyi (ruwa mai sanyi da ake amfani da shi don kawar da lalacewa da sauri) da fluorouracil (wanda aka fi sani da 5FU, maganin ciwon daji gama-gari).
Northern Sotho: Morago ga gore e tlošwe, ba swanetše go tlotša sehlare se se bitšwago Carnoy’s solution, gammogo le naetherotšene ya seela (seela sa go tonya kudu se se šomišwago go tloša ka potlako letlalo le le gobetšego) le fluorouracil (ye e tsebjago gape bjalo ka 5FU, e lego sehlare se se tlwaelegilego sa kankere).
Amharic: ከተወገደ በኋላ የካረኖይን ውህድ መድሃኒትን ከፈሳሽ ናይትሮጅን(የተጎዳ ቆዳን በፍጥነት ለማንሳት ጥቅም ላይ የሚውል እጅግ ቀዝቃዛ ፈሳሽ ) እና ፍሉሮኡራሲል (5FU በመባል የሚታወቀው ከተለመደው የካንሰር መድሃኒት) ጋር በአንድነት መጠቀም ይገባል።

English: After this treatment, the researchers recommended that a patient should have follow-up health checks for up to 25 years.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma lw’obujjanjabi buno, abanoonyereza baateesa nti omulwadde alina okubeera ng’akolwako okukebera okw’okulondoola okumala emyaka 25.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn ìtọ́jú àwọn aṣèwádìí dá a lábàá kí kí aláìsàn ó máa ṣe àyèwò lérawọn fún bí ọdún 25.
Zulu: Ngemuva kwalokhu kwelashwa, abacwaningi batusa ukuthi isiguli kufanele silandele ukuhlolwa kwezempilo kuze kufike eminyakeni engama-25.
Hausa: Bayan wannan magani, masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar cewa majiyyaci ya kamata ya duba lafiyarsa har zuwa shekaru 25.
Northern Sotho: Morago ga kalafo ye, banyakišiši ba šišintše gore molwetši o swanetše go lekolwa seemo sa gagwe sa maphelo go fihla go mengwaga ye 25.
Amharic: ከዚህ ህክምና በኋላ ታካሚው እስከ 25 አመታት የጤና ምርመራ ክትትል ማድረግ እንዳለበት ተመራማሪዎቹ መክረዋል።

English: They said this treatment was best for lesions smaller than a strawberry fruit (3 cm).
Luganda: Baagamba nti obujjanjabi buno businga kukola ku biwundu ebitaweza bunene bwa kibala kya nkenene (3 cm).
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní ìtọ́jú yìí dára fún àwọn ojú ọgbẹ́ tí ó kéré sí èso strawberry (3 cm).
Zulu: Bathi lokhu kwelashwa kwakungcono kakhulu izilonda ezincane kunesithelo se-strawberry (3 cm).
Hausa: Sun ce wannan magani ya fi dacewa ga raunuka masu ƙanƙanta fiye da ‘ya’yan itacen strawberry (3 cm).
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore kalafo ye e be e loketše dintho tše nnyane go seenywa sa seteroperi (3 cm).
Amharic: ይህ ህክምና ከአንድ እንጆሪ ፍሬ (3 ሴ.ሜ) ለሚያንሱ ቁስሎች ጥሩ እንደሚሆን ተናግረዋል።

English: For lesions bigger than 3 cm, the researchers recommended more attention.
Luganda: Ku biwundu ebisussa 3 cm, abanoonyereza baateesa obujjanjabi obusingawo.
Yoruba: Fún àwọn ojú ọgbẹ́ tí wọ́n ju 3 cm lọ, àwọn aṣèwádìí dábàá àkíyèsí síwájú síi.
Zulu: Ngezilonda ezinkulu kune-3 cm, abacwaningi batusa ukunakwa okwengeziwe.
Hausa: Dominn raunukan da suka fi girma fiye da 3 cm, masu bincike sun bayar da shawarar ƙarin kulawa.
Northern Sotho: Go dintho tše di fetago 3 cm, banyakišiši ba šišintše gore ba hwetše tlhokomelo ye kgolo.
Amharic: ከ3 ሴ.ሜ ለሚበልጡ ቁስሎች ግን የበለጠ ትኩረት እንዲሰጥ ተመራማሪዎቹ መክረዋል፡፡

English: They said doctors should first reduce the pressure inside the lesion and remove fluid, and also remove all tissues around the jaw.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abasawo balina okusooka okukendeeza omunyigirizo oguli munda w’ekiwundu baggyemu n’amazzi, era baggyemu n’ennyama yonna eyeetoolodde oluba.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé kí àwọn dókítà kọ́kọ́ mú àdínkù bá sísọ ojú ọgbẹ́ náà kí wọ́n sì tú omi inú rẹ̀ jáde, kí wọ́n sì tún yọ gbogbo àwọn ẹran tí ó yí àgbọ̀n ká.
Zulu: Bathe odokotela kufanele baqale behlise ingcindezi ngaphakathi kwesilonda bakhiphe uketshezi, baphinde bakhiphe zonke izicubu emhlathini.
Hausa: Sun ce ya kamata likitoci su fara rage matsin da ke cikin raunin da kuma cire ruwa, sannan su cire dukkan ƙyallen da ke kusa da muƙamuƙin.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore dingaka di swanetše go thoma ka go fokotša kgatelelo ka nthong le go tloša seela, gammogo le go tloša dinamana ka moka go rarela mohlagare.
Amharic: ዶክተሮች በመጀመሪያ ቁስሉ ውስጥ ያለውን ግፊት መቀነስ እና ፈሳሽን ማስወጣት ከዛ በመንጋጋው ዙሪያ ያሉትን ህብረ ህዋሳት በሙሉ ማስወገድ አለባቸው ብለዋል።

English: The bone should then be treated with Carnoy’s solution.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma eggumba lirina okujjanjabibwa ne Carnoy’s solution.
Yoruba: Kí egungun náà wá di títọ́jú pẹ̀lú ẹ̀pa Carnoy.
Zulu: Ithambo kufanele liphathwe ngekhambi likaCarnoy.
Hausa: Sannan a bi da ƙashin da maganin Carnoy.
Northern Sotho: Lerapo le swanetše go alafša ka Carnoy’s solution.
Amharic: ከዚያም አጥንቱ በካርኖይ ውህድ መድሃኒት መታከም ይኖርበታል።

English: They recommended that doctors should check on these patients every 2 months for 2 years.
Luganda: Baateesa nti abasawo balina okukebera ku balwadde bano buli myezi 2 okumala emyaka 2.
Yoruba: Wọ́n dá a lábàá pé kí àwọn dókítà máa ṣe àbẹ̀wò sí àwọn aláìsàn náà ní oṣù 2 fún ọdún 2.
Zulu: Batusa ukuthi odokotela kufanele bahlole lezi ziguli njalo ezinyangeni ezi-2 iminyaka emi-2.
Hausa: Sun bayar da shawarar cewa likitoci su duba waɗannan marasa lafiya kowane watanni 2 har tsawon shekaru 2.
Northern Sotho: Ba šišintše gore dingaka di swanetše go lekola balwetši ba dikgweding tše dingwe le tše dingwe tše 2 tekano ya mengwaga ye 2.
Amharic: ዶክተሮች ለእነዚህ ታካሚዎች በየ2 ወሩ ለ2 አመታት የማረጋገጫ ምርመራ ማድረግ እንደሚኖርባቸው መክረዋል።

English: If a patient had many lesions, doctors could also drain them some special hospital equipment.
Luganda: Singa omulwadde aba yalina ebiwundu bingi, abasawo era basobola okubikaza nga bakozesa ekyuma eky’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Tí aláìsàn kan bá ní ojú ọgbẹ́ púpọ̀, dókítà lè mú wọn gbẹ pẹ̀lú àwọn ohun-èlò ilé-ìwòsàn pàtàkì.
Zulu: Uma isiguli sinezilonda eziningi, odokotela bangasikhipha nemishini ethile yasesibhedlela ekhethekile.
Hausa: Idan majiyyaci yana da raunuka da yawa, likitoci za su iya matse su da wasu kayan aikin asibiti na musamman.
Northern Sotho: Ge molwetši a be a na le dintho tše ntši, dingaka di ka di gamola ka setlabela sa moswananoši sa sepetlele.
Amharic: ታካሚዉ ብዙ ቁስሎች ካሉት ዶክተሮች በአንዳንድ ልዩ የሆስፒታል ልዩ መሳሪያዎች ሊያደርቋቸው ይችላሉ።

English: But generally, the studies reviewed showed that in most cases, if doctors removed the lesion and applied 5FU, patients would not develop OKC again.
Luganda: Naye okutwaliza awamu, okunoonyereza okwekenneenyezebwa kwalaga nti ebiseera ebisinga, singa abasawo baggyamu ekiwundu ne bassaawo 5FU, abalwadde tebaddamu kufuna OKC.
Yoruba: Sùgbọ́n ní àpapọ̀, àtúnyẹ̀wò iṣẹ́ ìwádìí náà fi hàn pé lọ́pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìgbà, tí àwọn dókítà bá mú ojú ọgbẹ́ náà kúrò tí wọ́n sì fi 5fu sí i, àwọn aláìsàn kò ní ní OKC mọ́.
Zulu: Kodwa ngokuvamile, izifundo ezibuyekeziwe zabonisa ukuthi ezimweni eziningi, uma odokotela besusa isilonda futhi basebenzise i-5FU, iziguli ngeke ziphinde zithuthukise i-OKC.
Hausa: Amma gabaɗaya, binciken da aka yi bita sun nuna cewa a mafi yawan lokuta, idan likitoci sun cire raunin kuma suka shafa 5FU, marasa lafiya ba za su sake kamuwa da OKC ba.
Northern Sotho: Eupša ka kakaretšo, dinyakišišo tše di lekotšwego di bontšhitše gore dinakong tše ntši, ge dingaka di tlošitše ntho le go tlotša 5FU, balwetši ba ka se be le OKC gape.
Amharic: ነገር ግን በአጠቃላይ የተገመገሙት ጥናቶች እንደሚያሳዩት አብዛኛውን ጊዜ ዶክተሮች ቁስሉን ካስወገዱ እና 5FUን ከተጠቀሙ ታካሚዎች ኦ.ኬ.ሲን እንደገና አያዳብሩም።

English: They however cautioned that the evidence for these treatments was not always strong, and they found relatively few scientific articles on this subject.
Luganda: Wabula baalabula nti obujulizi ku nzijanjaba zino tebwalinga bwa maanyi, era baafuna atiko z’ekinnasaayansi ntono ku nsonga eno.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣèkìlọ̀ bákan náà pé ẹ̀rí fún àwọn ìtọ́jú wọ̀nyìí kì í sábàá lágbára, wọ́n sì rí àwọn ìwé àpilẹ̀kọ ajẹmọ́ sáyẹ́ǹsì tí ó jọra lórí kókó yìí.
Zulu: Nokho baxwayise ngokuthi ubufakazi balokhu kwelashwa abuqinile ngaso sonke isikhathi, futhi bathola izihloko ezimbalwa zesayensi ezikhuluma ngale ndaba.
Hausa: Duk da haka sun yi gargaɗin cewa shaidar waɗannan jiyya ba koyaushe suke da ƙarfi ba, kuma sun sami maƙalolin kimiyya ‘yan kaɗan a kan wannan batu.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo ba lemošitše gore bohlatse bja dikalafo tše bo be bo sa se na maatla ka mehla, gomme ba utollotše palo ye e sa kgotsofatšego ya diathikhele tša saentshe ka ga hlogopoledišano ye.
Amharic: ነገር ግን እነዚህ የህክምና ማስረጃዎች ሁልጊዜ ጠንካራ እንዳልሆኑ አስጠንቅቀው በዚሁ ርእሰ ጉዳይ ላይም አንጻራዊ የሆኑ ጥቂት ሳይንሳዊ ጽሁፎችን አግኝተዋል።

English: The researchers also did not conduct their own experiments to inform these recommendations; rather, they attempted to collate the best known treatment options from studies done by other researchers.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era tebaakola kugezesa kwabwe ku lwabwe okuwagira ebiteeso bino; wabula, baagezaako okuleeta awamu enzijanjaba ezisinga obulungi ezimanyiddwa okuva mu kunoonyereza okwakolebwa abanoonyereza abalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí bákan náà kò ṣe àwọn àyẹ̀wò ti wọn láti dá àwọn àbá wọ̀nyìí, wọ́n gbìyànjú láti ṣe àkójọ àwọn ọ̀nà ìtọ́jú tí ó dára ní mímọ̀ jù láti inú àwọn ìwádìí tí àwọn aṣèwádìí mìíràn ṣe.
Zulu: Abacwaningi futhi abazange benze izivivinyo zabo ukuze bazise lezi zincomo; kunalokho, bazame ukuhlanganisa izindlela zokwelapha ezaziwa kakhulu ezifundweni ezenziwe abanye abacwaningi.
Hausa: Masu binciken kuma ba su gudanar da nasu gwaje-gwajen don sanar da waɗannan shawarwari ba; maimakon haka, sun yi ƙoƙarin tattara mafi kyawun zaɓin jiyya daga binciken da wasu masu bincike suka yi a baya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ga se ba dira le maitekelo a bona go thekga ditšhišinyo tše; eupša, ba lekile go kgoboketša dikgetho tša dikalafo tše di tumilego kudu go tšwa dinyakišišong tše di dirilwego ke banyakišiši ba bangwe.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እነዚህን ምክሮች ለማቅረብ የራሳቸውን ሙከራዎች አላደረጉም ይልቁንስ የሞከሩት በሌሎች ተመራማሪዎች ከተደረጉ ጥናቶች ውስጥ በጣም የታወቁ የህክምና አማራጮችን ለማቀናበር ነበር ።

English: These researchers, based in Nigeria and USA, therefore recommended more studies in different countries to test the success of the treatments recommended here.
Luganda: Noolwekyo, abanoonyereza bano, okuva mu Nigeria ne USA, baateesa wabeewo okunoonyereza okulala mu mawanga ag’enjawulo okugezesa enkola y’enzijanjaba eziteesebwa wano.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí yìí kalẹ̀ sí orílẹ̀-èdè Nigeria and USA, nítorí náà wọ́n dábàá àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí láti àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn láti lè ṣàyẹ̀wò àṣeyọrí àwọn ìtọ́jú tí wọ́n dábàá níbí.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi, abazinze eNigeria nase-USA, ngakho-ke bancome izifundo ezengeziwe emazweni ahlukene ukuze kuhlolwe impumelelo yokwelashwa okunconyiwe lapha.
Hausa: Waɗannan masu binciken, suna zaune ne a Nijeriya da Amurka, don haka, sun bayar da shawarar ƙarin nazari a ƙasashe daban-daban don gwada nasarar maganin da aka bayar da shawarar a nan.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba, bao ba tšwago go la Nigeria le USA, ka gona ba šišintše gore go dirwe dinyakišišo tše dingwe ka dinageng tše di fapafapanego go dira diteko tša katlego ya dikalafo tše di šišinywago mo.
Amharic: ስለዚህ በናይጄሪያ እና አሜሪካ የሚኖሩት እነዚህ ተመራማሪዎች እዚህ ላይ የቀረቡትን ህክምናዎች ስኬታማነት ለመፈተሽ ተጨማሪ ጥናቶች በተለያዩ ሃገሮች እንዲደረጉ መክረዋል።

English: They also encouraged doctors to consider other patient conditions during treatment.
Luganda: Era baasaba abasawo okulowooza ku mbeera z’abalwadde endala mu kubajjanjaba.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún gba àwọn dókítà níyànjú láti wo ipò àwọn aláìsàn mìíràn lásìkò ìtọ́jú.
Zulu: Baphinde bakhuthaza odokotela ukuthi bacabangele ezinye izimo zesiguli ngesikhathi sokwelashwa.
Hausa: Sun kuma ƙarfafa gwiwar likitocin da su yi la’akari da sauran yanayin marasa lafiya yayin jiyya.
Northern Sotho: Ba hlohleleditše le dingaka go lebelela maemo a mangwe a balwetši nakong ya kalafo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በህክምናው ወቅት ሌሎች የታካሚ ሁኔታዎችን ግምት ውስጥ እንዲያስገቡ ዶክተሮችን አበረታተዋል።

English: By taking together results from existing studies, researchers defined clear steps that doctors could follow to identify and treat patients who have a jaw disease called ‘odontogenic karatocyst’ (OKC).
Luganda: Nga bageraageranya ebyava mu kunoonyereza okwakolebwa edda, abanoonyereza baalaga emitendera emirambulukufu abasawo gye basobola okugoberera okuzuula n’okujjanjaba abalwadde abalina obulwadde bw’emba obuyitibwa ‘odontogenic karatocyst’ (OKC).
Yoruba: Nípa mímú àwọn àbájáde papọ̀ láti inú àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí tí ó ti wà nílẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀, àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣàlàyé àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ tí ó hàn gbangba tí àwọn dókítà lè tẹ̀lé láti ṣe ìdámọ̀ àti láti tọ́jú àwọn aláìsàn tí ó ní ààrun àgbọ̀n tí à ń pẹ̀ ní ‘odọntojẹ́ní kẹratósíìsí’ (OKC).
Zulu: Ngokuthatha ndawonye imiphumela evela ezifundweni ezikhona, abacwaningi bachaza izinyathelo ezicacile odokotela abangazilandela ukuze bakhombe futhi belaphe iziguli ezinesifo somhlathi esibizwa nge-‘odontogenic karatocyst’ (OKC).
Hausa: Ta hanyar tattara sakamako daga binciken da aka gudanar, masu binciken sun bayyana cikakkun matakai da likitoci za su iya bi domin ganowa da kuma kula da marasa lafiya da ke da ciwon muƙamuƙi wanda ake kira 'odontogenic karatocyst' (OKC).
Northern Sotho: Ka go šomiša le dipoelo go tšwa dinyakišišong tše di lego gona, banyakišiši ba hlathollotše magato a maleba ao dingaka di ka a latelago go lemoga le go alafa balwetši bao ba nago le bolwetši bja mohlagare bjo bo bitšwago ‘odontogenic karatocyst’ (OKC).
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች የነባር ጥናቶችን ውጤት በአንድ ላይ በማሰባሰብ ኦዶንቶጄኒክ ኬራቶሲስት(ኦ.ኬ.ሲ) የተባለ የመንጋጋ በሽታ ያለባቸውን ታማሚዎች ለመለየት እና ለማከም ዶክተሮች ሊከተሉ የሚገቧቸውን ግልጽ እርምጃዎች አስቀምጠዋል።

English: An OKC is a lesion, or an unusual growth, on a person’s jaw.
Luganda: OKC buba buvune, oba ekizimba ekitali kya bulijjo, ku luba lw’omuntu.
Yoruba: OKC jẹ́ ọgbẹ́, tàbí ara wíwú àbaàdì, ní àgbọ̀n ènìyàn.
Zulu: I-OKC iyisilonda, noma ukukhula okungavamile, emhlathini womuntu.
Hausa: OKC wani rauni ne, ko girma mai ban mamaki, a kan muƙamuƙin mutum.
Northern Sotho: OKC ke ntho, goba kgolo ye e sa tlwaelegago, mohlagareng wa motho.
Amharic: ኦ.ኬ.ሲ በሰው መንጋጋ ላይ ያለ ቁስል ወይም ያልተለመደ እድገት ነው።

English: Doctors find the condition difficult to treat, and patients often develop another OKC even after successful treatment.
Luganda: Abasawo bakaluubirirwa okujjanjaba ekizibu kino, era abalwadde batera okufuna OKC ne bwe baba nga babadde bajjanjabiddwa bulungi.
Yoruba: Ó máa ń nira fún àwọn dókítà láti tọ́jú, àwọn aláìsàn sì tún máa ń ni OKC mìíràn lẹ́yìn ìgbà tí a bá ti ṣe àṣeyọrí lórí ìtọ́jú ọ̀kan.
Zulu: Odokotela bakuthola kunzima ukwelapha lesi simo, futhi iziguli zivame ukuthuthukisa enye i-OKC ngisho nangemva kokwelashwa okuphumelelayo.
Hausa: Likitoci suna shan wahalar magance raunin, kuma sau da yawa marasa lafiya sukan sake kamuwa da wani OKC koda bayan nasarar magani.
Northern Sotho: Dingaka di hwetša bolwetši bjo bo le boima go bo alafa, gomme gantši balwetši ba ba le OKC ye nngwe le ka morago ga kalafo ya katlego.
Amharic: ዶክተሮች ሁኔታውን ለማከም አስቸጋሪ ሆኖ አግኝተውታል አብዛኛውን ጊዜም ታካሚዎች ከተሳካ ህክምና በኋላም እንኳ ሌላ ኦ.ኬ.ሲ ያዳብራሉ።

English: Doctors are thus looking for ways to effectively and permanently heal these jaw lesions.
Luganda: Noolwekyo, abasawo banoonya engeri ezituukiridde ez’okujjanjaba n'okuwonyeza ddala obuvune bw'emba buno.
Yoruba: Àwọn dókíta,̀ nítorí náa,̀ ń wá àwọn ọ̀nà tí yóò ṣiṣẹ́ láti lè ṣe ìwòsàn àwọn ọgbẹ́ àgbọ̀n wọ̀nyìí pátápátá.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke odokotela bafuna izindlela zokuphulukisa ngempumelelo futhi unomphela lezi zilonda zomhlathi.
Hausa: Domin haka, likitoci suna neman hanyoyin da za a bi domin warkar da waɗannan raunukan muƙamuƙi cikin inganci da kuma dindindin.
Northern Sotho: Ka fao dingaka di nyakana le ditsela tša go fodiša ka tshwanelo le sa ruri dintho tše tša mohlagareng.
Amharic: ስለዚህ ዶክተሮች እነዚህን የመንጋጋ ቁስሎችን በብቃት እና በቋሚነት ለመፈወስ መንገዶችን እየፈለጉ ነው።

English: In this study, researchers looked for the key steps doctors should take to identify and treat the disease.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baanoonya emitendera emikulu abasawo gye balina okuyitamu okuzuula n’okujjanjaba obulwadde buno.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí wá àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ tí ó jẹ́ kókó tí àwọn dókítà yẹ kí wọn ó gbẹ́ láti lè ṣe ìdámọ̀ àti láti tọ́jú ààrùn náà.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babheke izinyathelo ezibalulekile okufanele bazithathe odokotela ukuze bahlonze futhi belaphe lesi sifo.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun nemi mahimman matakan da ya kamata likitoci su bi domin ganowa da kuma magance cutar.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba lebeletše magato a bohlokwa ao dingaka di swanetšego go a tšea go lemoga le go alafa bolwetši.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች በሽታውን ለመለየት እና ለማከም ዶክተሮች ሊወስዱ የሚገቧቸውን ቁልፍ እርምጃዎች ፈልገዋል።

English: They did this by searching through existing literature, or scientific articles, about OKC.
Luganda: Kino baakikola nga batunula mu biwandiiko ebiriwo, oba atiko z’ekinnasaayansi, ezikwata ku OKC.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe èyí nípa wíwo inú àwọn ìwé àkọsílẹ̀ tí ó ti wà nílẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀, tàbí àwọn ìwé àpilẹ̀kọ ajẹmọ́ sáyẹ́ǹsì, nípa OKC.
Zulu: Lokhu bakwenze ngokusesha izincwadi ezikhona, noma izihloko zesayensi, mayelana ne-OKC.
Hausa: Sun yi hakan ne ta hanyar binciken ayyukan da aka yi, ko maƙalolin kimiyya game da OKC.
Northern Sotho: Ba dirile se ka go phuruphutša go dingwalo tše di lego gona, goba diathikhele tša mahlale, mabapi le OKC.
Amharic: ይህንንም ያደረጉት ስለ ኦ.ኬ.ሲ የተጻፉትን ነባር ጽሁፎች ወይም ሳይንሳዊ መጣጥፎች በመመርመር ነው።

English: They were specifically looking for information on how doctors managed OKC over a period of 1 year, as reported in the 46 articles they found.
Luganda: Okusingira ddala baali banoonya obubaka obukwata ku ngeri abasawo gye bajjanjabamu OKC okumala ekiseera kya mwaka 1, nga bwe bweyolekera mu atiko 46 ze baazuula.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ń kanlẹ̀ wá àlàyé nípa bí àwọn dókítà ṣe ń ṣe àmójútó OKC láàrin ọdún 1, gẹ́gẹ́ bí wọ́n ṣe jábọ̀ rẹ̀ nínú àwọn ìwé àpilẹ̀kọ 46 tí wọ́n ṣàwárí.
Zulu: Babefuna ngokukhethekile ulwazi mayelana nendlela odokotela abaphatha ngayo i-OKC esikhathini esingangonyaka ongu-1, njengoba kubikwe ezihlokweni ze-46 abazithola.
Hausa: Suna neman bayanai na musamman a kan yadda likitoci suka kula OKC a cikin tsawon shekara 1, kamar yadda aka ruwaito a cikin maƙaloli guda 46 da suka samu.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba tloga ba nyakana le tshedimošo ya ka moo dingaka di laotšego OKC mo pakeng ya ngwaga o 1, bjalo ka ge go begilwe go dingwalo tše 46 tšeo ba di hweditšego.
Amharic: ካገኟቸው 46 መጣጥፎች ላይ በተለይ ዶክተሮች ኦ.ኬ.ሲን ከ1አመት በላይ ለሚሆን ጊዜ እንዴት እንደተቆጣጠሩት የተዘገበውን መረጃ ፈልገው ነበር።

English: The researchers found that OKC was more common in males than females, and could affect people up to the age of 90, even though it was common between ages 20 and 30.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakizuula nti OKC yali nnyo mu basajja okusinga mu bakazi, era asobola okukwata abantu okutuuka ku b’emyaka 90, newankubadde nga yali nnyo mu b’emyaka 20 ku 30.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí rí I pé OKC wọ́pọ̀ láàrin àwọn akọ ju àwọn abo lọ, ó sì lè kọlu ènìyàn títí di ọjọ́ orí 90, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé láàrin ọjọ́ orí 20 àti 30 ni ó ti wọ́pọ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi i-OKC yayivame kakhulu kwabesilisa kunabesifazane, futhi ingathinta abantu kuze kube yiminyaka engu-90, nakuba yayivamile phakathi kweminyaka engu-20 ne-30.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa OKC ya fi yawa a cikin maza fiye da mata, kuma yana iya shafar mutane har zuwa shekaru 90, duk da cewa yana da yawa a tsakanin masu shekaru 20 zuwa 30.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše gore bolwetši bja OKC bo be bo tlwaelegile kudu go banna go feta go basadi, le gona bo ka swara batho go fihla ka mengwaga ye 90, le ge bo be bo tlwaelegile magareng ga mengwaga ye 20 le 30.
Amharic: ኦ.ኬ.ሲ ከሴቶች በበለጠ በወንዶች ላይ የሚከሰት መሆኑን እና ምንም እንኳ በ20 እና በ30 አመት እድሜዎች መካከል የተለመደ ቢሆንም እስከ 90 አመት እድሜ ያላቸውን ሰዎች ሊያጠቃ እንደሚችል ተመራማሪዎች ደርሰውበታል።

English: The disease affected mostly the lower jaw.
Luganda: Obulwadde buno bwasinga kukosa luba lwa wansi.
Yoruba: Àgbọ̀n ìsàlẹ̀ ni ààrùn yìí máa ń kọlù jùlọ.
Zulu: Lesi sifo sithinta kakhulu umhlathi ongezansi.
Hausa: Cutar takan shafi yawancin muƙamuƙi na ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Bolwetši bo amile kudu mohlagare wa ka fase.
Amharic: በሽታው በአብዛኛው የሚያጠቃው የታችኛውን መንጋጋ ነው።

English: OKC starts from inside the bone, with swelling of the jaw only visible later.
Luganda: OKC atandikira mu ggumba munda, ng’oluba okuzimba kirabika luvannyuma.
Yoruba: Láti inú egungun ni OKC ti máa ń bẹ̀rẹ̀, lẹ́yìn ìgbà náà ni àgbọ̀n híhú yóò fara hàn.
Zulu: I-OKC iqala ngaphakathi kwethambo, nokuvuvukala komhlathi kubonakala kamuva.
Hausa: OKC yana farawa ne daga cikin ƙashi, tare da kumburin muƙamuƙi kawai daga baya.
Northern Sotho: OKC e thoma ka gare ga lerapo, moo go ruruga ga mohlagare go lemogwago ka moragonyana.
Amharic: ኦ.ኬ.ሲ የሚጀምረው ከአጥንት ውስጥ ሲሆን ወደ በኋላ ላይ የሚታይ የመንጋጋ እብጠትን ያስከትላል ።

English: Patients usually felt pain and had some discharge (fluid, like pus, that leaks from a wound or lesion), and the roots of their teeth may move out of place.
Luganda: Abalwadde batera okuwulira obulumi era bavaamu amazzi (agalinga amasira, agatonnya okuva mu kiwundu), n’emirandira gy’amannyo gaabwe giyinza okuva mu kifo kyagyo.
Yoruba: Àwọn aláìsàn máa ń jẹ ìrora wọ́n sì máa tú ètútú bi (omi, ọyún, tí ó máa ń jáde láti ojú egbò tàbí ojú ọgbẹ́), ìṣàlẹ̀ eyín wọn lè wọ́ kúrò ní ibi tí ó wà.
Zulu: Iziguli ngokuvamile zazizwa ubuhlungu futhi ziphuma uketshezi oluthile (uketshezi, njengobomvu, oluvuza esilondeni noma esilonda), futhi izimpande zamazinyo zingase zisuke endaweni.
Hausa: Marasa lafiya yawanci suna jin zafi kuma suna samun ɗan ruwa (ruwa, kamar mugunya, wadda take fitowa daga ciwon ko rauni), kuma tushen haƙoransu suna iya matsawa daga wurin.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši gantši ba be ba e kwa bohloko ebile ba etšwa meetsana (seela, se bjalo ka boladu, bjo bo elago go tšwa sešong goba nthong), ebile medu ya meno a bona e ka šutha.
Amharic: ታካሚዎች በአብዛኛው የህመም ስሜት እና አንዳንድ ፍስሳት ( እንደ መግል ያሉ ፈሳሾች ከተጎዳው ወይም ከቁስሉ የሚያዡ )ይኖራቸዋል እንዲሁም የጥርሶቻቸው ስሮች ከቦታቸው ሊወጡ ይችላሉ።

English: They recommended that doctors remove the entire lesion and nearby teeth.
Luganda: Baateesa nti abasawo baggyeyo ekiwundu kyonna n’amannyo agaliraanyeewo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n dá a lábàá pé kí àwọn dókítà yọ gbogbo ọgbẹ́ àti àwọn ẹyín itòsí kúrò.
Zulu: Batusa ukuthi odokotela basuse sonke isilonda namazinyo aseduze.
Hausa: Sun bayar da shawarar cewa likitoci su cire gabaɗaya raunin da haƙori na kusa.
Northern Sotho: Ba šišintše gore dingaka di tloše ntho ya bona ka moka le meno a kgauswi.
Amharic: ዶክተሮች ሁሉንም ቁስል እና በቅርቡ ያሉትን ጥርሶች እንዲያስወግዱ መክረዋል።

English: Once removed, they should apply a medicine called Carnoy’s solution, together with liquid nitrogen (a very cold liquid used to quickly remove damaged skin) and fluorouracil (also known as 5FU, a common cancer medicine).
Luganda: Bwe biggyibwayo, balina okussaawo eddagala eriyitibwa Carnoy’s solution, awamu ne nitrogen ow’amazzi (amazzi agannyogoga ennyo agakozesebwa okuggyawo olususu olulwadde) ne fluorouracil (era amanyiddwa nga 5FU, eddagala erikozesebwa ennyo mu kujjanjaba kookolo).
Yoruba: Ní kété tí a bá ti yọ ọ́ kúrò, kí wọ́n fi oògùn kan tí wọ́n pè ní ẹ̀pa Carnoy si i, papọ̣̀ mọ́ nítírójíìnì olómi (omi tó tutù gan-an tí a máa ń lò láti bó àwọ̣̀ ara tí ó bá ti kú) àti fúróráàsì (tí a tún mọ̀ sí 5FU, oògun jẹjẹrẹ tí ó wọ́pọ̣̀).
Zulu: Uma sebekhishiwe, kufanele bafake umuthi obizwa ngeCarnoy’s solution, kanye ne-nitrogen ewuketshezi (uketshezi olubanda kakhulu olusetshenziselwa ukususa ngokushesha isikhumba esilimele) kanye ne-fluorouracil (eyaziwa nangokuthi i-5FU, umuthi ovamile womdlavuza).
Hausa: Da zarar an cire su, sai su yi amfani da wani magani mai suna maganin Carnoy, tare da ruwa mai sanyi (ruwa mai sanyi da ake amfani da shi don kawar da lalacewa da sauri) da fluorouracil (wanda aka fi sani da 5FU, maganin ciwon daji gama-gari).
Northern Sotho: Morago ga gore e tlošwe, ba swanetše go tlotša sehlare se se bitšwago Carnoy’s solution, gammogo le naetherotšene ya seela (seela sa go tonya kudu se se šomišwago go tloša ka potlako letlalo le le gobetšego) le fluorouracil (ye e tsebjago gape bjalo ka 5FU, e lego sehlare se se tlwaelegilego sa kankere).
Amharic: ከተወገደ በኋላ የካረኖይን ውህድ መድሃኒትን ከፈሳሽ ናይትሮጅን(የተጎዳ ቆዳን በፍጥነት ለማንሳት ጥቅም ላይ የሚውል እጅግ ቀዝቃዛ ፈሳሽ ) እና ፍሉሮኡራሲል (5FU በመባል የሚታወቀው ከተለመደው የካንሰር መድሃኒት) ጋር በአንድነት መጠቀም ይገባል።

English: After this treatment, the researchers recommended that a patient should have follow-up health checks for up to 25 years.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma lw’obujjanjabi buno, abanoonyereza baateesa nti omulwadde alina okubeera ng’akolwako okukebera okw’okulondoola okumala emyaka 25.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn ìtọ́jú àwọn aṣèwádìí dá a lábàá kí kí aláìsàn ó máa ṣe àyèwò lérawọn fún bí ọdún 25.
Zulu: Ngemuva kwalokhu kwelashwa, abacwaningi batusa ukuthi isiguli kufanele silandele ukuhlolwa kwezempilo kuze kufike eminyakeni engama-25.
Hausa: Bayan wannan magani, masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar cewa majiyyaci ya kamata ya duba lafiyarsa har zuwa shekaru 25.
Northern Sotho: Morago ga kalafo ye, banyakišiši ba šišintše gore molwetši o swanetše go lekolwa seemo sa gagwe sa maphelo go fihla go mengwaga ye 25.
Amharic: ከዚህ ህክምና በኋላ ታካሚው እስከ 25 አመታት የጤና ምርመራ ክትትል ማድረግ እንዳለበት ተመራማሪዎቹ መክረዋል።

English: They said this treatment was best for lesions smaller than a strawberry fruit (3 cm).
Luganda: Baagamba nti obujjanjabi buno businga kukola ku biwundu ebitaweza bunene bwa kibala kya nkenene (3 cm).
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní ìtọ́jú yìí dára fún àwọn ojú ọgbẹ́ tí ó kéré sí èso strawberry (3 cm).
Zulu: Bathi lokhu kwelashwa kwakungcono kakhulu izilonda ezincane kunesithelo se-strawberry (3 cm).
Hausa: Sun ce wannan magani ya fi dacewa ga raunuka masu ƙanƙanta fiye da ‘ya’yan itacen strawberry (3 cm).
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore kalafo ye e be e loketše dintho tše nnyane go seenywa sa seteroperi (3 cm).
Amharic: ይህ ህክምና ከአንድ እንጆሪ ፍሬ (3 ሴ.ሜ) ለሚያንሱ ቁስሎች ጥሩ እንደሚሆን ተናግረዋል።

English: For lesions bigger than 3 cm, the researchers recommended more attention.
Luganda: Ku biwundu ebisussa 3 cm, abanoonyereza baateesa obujjanjabi obusingawo.
Yoruba: Fún àwọn ojú ọgbẹ́ tí wọ́n ju 3 cm lọ, àwọn aṣèwádìí dábàá àkíyèsí síwájú síi.
Zulu: Ngezilonda ezinkulu kune-3 cm, abacwaningi batusa ukunakwa okwengeziwe.
Hausa: Dominn raunukan da suka fi girma fiye da 3 cm, masu bincike sun bayar da shawarar ƙarin kulawa.
Northern Sotho: Go dintho tše di fetago 3 cm, banyakišiši ba šišintše gore ba hwetše tlhokomelo ye kgolo.
Amharic: ከ3 ሴ.ሜ ለሚበልጡ ቁስሎች ግን የበለጠ ትኩረት እንዲሰጥ ተመራማሪዎቹ መክረዋል፡፡

English: They said doctors should first reduce the pressure inside the lesion and remove fluid, and also remove all tissues around the jaw.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abasawo balina okusooka okukendeeza omunyigirizo oguli munda w’ekiwundu baggyemu n’amazzi, era baggyemu n’ennyama yonna eyeetoolodde oluba.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé kí àwọn dókítà kọ́kọ́ mú àdínkù bá sísọ ojú ọgbẹ́ náà kí wọ́n sì tú omi inú rẹ̀ jáde, kí wọ́n sì tún yọ gbogbo àwọn ẹran tí ó yí àgbọ̀n ká.
Zulu: Bathe odokotela kufanele baqale behlise ingcindezi ngaphakathi kwesilonda bakhiphe uketshezi, baphinde bakhiphe zonke izicubu emhlathini.
Hausa: Sun ce ya kamata likitoci su fara rage matsin da ke cikin raunin da kuma cire ruwa, sannan su cire dukkan ƙyallen da ke kusa da muƙamuƙin.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore dingaka di swanetše go thoma ka go fokotša kgatelelo ka nthong le go tloša seela, gammogo le go tloša dinamana ka moka go rarela mohlagare.
Amharic: ዶክተሮች በመጀመሪያ ቁስሉ ውስጥ ያለውን ግፊት መቀነስ እና ፈሳሽን ማስወጣት ከዛ በመንጋጋው ዙሪያ ያሉትን ህብረ ህዋሳት በሙሉ ማስወገድ አለባቸው ብለዋል።

English: The bone should then be treated with Carnoy’s solution.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma eggumba lirina okujjanjabibwa ne Carnoy’s solution.
Yoruba: Kí egungun náà wá di títọ́jú pẹ̀lú ẹ̀pa Carnoy.
Zulu: Ithambo kufanele liphathwe ngekhambi likaCarnoy.
Hausa: Sannan a bi da ƙashin da maganin Carnoy.
Northern Sotho: Lerapo le swanetše go alafša ka Carnoy’s solution.
Amharic: ከዚያም አጥንቱ በካርኖይ ውህድ መድሃኒት መታከም ይኖርበታል።

English: They recommended that doctors should check on these patients every 2 months for 2 years.
Luganda: Baateesa nti abasawo balina okukebera ku balwadde bano buli myezi 2 okumala emyaka 2.
Yoruba: Wọ́n dá a lábàá pé kí àwọn dókítà máa ṣe àbẹ̀wò sí àwọn aláìsàn náà ní oṣù 2 fún ọdún 2.
Zulu: Batusa ukuthi odokotela kufanele bahlole lezi ziguli njalo ezinyangeni ezi-2 iminyaka emi-2.
Hausa: Sun bayar da shawarar cewa likitoci su duba waɗannan marasa lafiya kowane watanni 2 har tsawon shekaru 2.
Northern Sotho: Ba šišintše gore dingaka di swanetše go lekola balwetši ba dikgweding tše dingwe le tše dingwe tše 2 tekano ya mengwaga ye 2.
Amharic: ዶክተሮች ለእነዚህ ታካሚዎች በየ2 ወሩ ለ2 አመታት የማረጋገጫ ምርመራ ማድረግ እንደሚኖርባቸው መክረዋል።

English: If a patient had many lesions, doctors could also drain them some special hospital equipment.
Luganda: Singa omulwadde aba yalina ebiwundu bingi, abasawo era basobola okubikaza nga bakozesa ekyuma eky’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Tí aláìsàn kan bá ní ojú ọgbẹ́ púpọ̀, dókítà lè mú wọn gbẹ pẹ̀lú àwọn ohun-èlò ilé-ìwòsàn pàtàkì.
Zulu: Uma isiguli sinezilonda eziningi, odokotela bangasikhipha nemishini ethile yasesibhedlela ekhethekile.
Hausa: Idan majiyyaci yana da raunuka da yawa, likitoci za su iya matse su da wasu kayan aikin asibiti na musamman.
Northern Sotho: Ge molwetši a be a na le dintho tše ntši, dingaka di ka di gamola ka setlabela sa moswananoši sa sepetlele.
Amharic: ታካሚዉ ብዙ ቁስሎች ካሉት ዶክተሮች በአንዳንድ ልዩ የሆስፒታል ልዩ መሳሪያዎች ሊያደርቋቸው ይችላሉ።

English: But generally, the studies reviewed showed that in most cases, if doctors removed the lesion and applied 5FU, patients would not develop OKC again.
Luganda: Naye okutwaliza awamu, okunoonyereza okwekenneenyezebwa kwalaga nti ebiseera ebisinga, singa abasawo baggyamu ekiwundu ne bassaawo 5FU, abalwadde tebaddamu kufuna OKC.
Yoruba: Sùgbọ́n ní àpapọ̀, àtúnyẹ̀wò iṣẹ́ ìwádìí náà fi hàn pé lọ́pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìgbà, tí àwọn dókítà bá mú ojú ọgbẹ́ náà kúrò tí wọ́n sì fi 5fu sí i, àwọn aláìsàn kò ní ní OKC mọ́.
Zulu: Kodwa ngokuvamile, izifundo ezibuyekeziwe zabonisa ukuthi ezimweni eziningi, uma odokotela besusa isilonda futhi basebenzise i-5FU, iziguli ngeke ziphinde zithuthukise i-OKC.
Hausa: Amma gabaɗaya, binciken da aka yi bita sun nuna cewa a mafi yawan lokuta, idan likitoci sun cire raunin kuma suka shafa 5FU, marasa lafiya ba za su sake kamuwa da OKC ba.
Northern Sotho: Eupša ka kakaretšo, dinyakišišo tše di lekotšwego di bontšhitše gore dinakong tše ntši, ge dingaka di tlošitše ntho le go tlotša 5FU, balwetši ba ka se be le OKC gape.
Amharic: ነገር ግን በአጠቃላይ የተገመገሙት ጥናቶች እንደሚያሳዩት አብዛኛውን ጊዜ ዶክተሮች ቁስሉን ካስወገዱ እና 5FUን ከተጠቀሙ ታካሚዎች ኦ.ኬ.ሲን እንደገና አያዳብሩም።

English: They however cautioned that the evidence for these treatments was not always strong, and they found relatively few scientific articles on this subject.
Luganda: Wabula baalabula nti obujulizi ku nzijanjaba zino tebwalinga bwa maanyi, era baafuna atiko z’ekinnasaayansi ntono ku nsonga eno.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣèkìlọ̀ bákan náà pé ẹ̀rí fún àwọn ìtọ́jú wọ̀nyìí kì í sábàá lágbára, wọ́n sì rí àwọn ìwé àpilẹ̀kọ ajẹmọ́ sáyẹ́ǹsì tí ó jọra lórí kókó yìí.
Zulu: Nokho baxwayise ngokuthi ubufakazi balokhu kwelashwa abuqinile ngaso sonke isikhathi, futhi bathola izihloko ezimbalwa zesayensi ezikhuluma ngale ndaba.
Hausa: Duk da haka sun yi gargaɗin cewa shaidar waɗannan jiyya ba koyaushe suke da ƙarfi ba, kuma sun sami maƙalolin kimiyya ‘yan kaɗan a kan wannan batu.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo ba lemošitše gore bohlatse bja dikalafo tše bo be bo sa se na maatla ka mehla, gomme ba utollotše palo ye e sa kgotsofatšego ya diathikhele tša saentshe ka ga hlogopoledišano ye.
Amharic: ነገር ግን እነዚህ የህክምና ማስረጃዎች ሁልጊዜ ጠንካራ እንዳልሆኑ አስጠንቅቀው በዚሁ ርእሰ ጉዳይ ላይም አንጻራዊ የሆኑ ጥቂት ሳይንሳዊ ጽሁፎችን አግኝተዋል።

English: The researchers also did not conduct their own experiments to inform these recommendations; rather, they attempted to collate the best known treatment options from studies done by other researchers.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era tebaakola kugezesa kwabwe ku lwabwe okuwagira ebiteeso bino; wabula, baagezaako okuleeta awamu enzijanjaba ezisinga obulungi ezimanyiddwa okuva mu kunoonyereza okwakolebwa abanoonyereza abalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí bákan náà kò ṣe àwọn àyẹ̀wò ti wọn láti dá àwọn àbá wọ̀nyìí, wọ́n gbìyànjú láti ṣe àkójọ àwọn ọ̀nà ìtọ́jú tí ó dára ní mímọ̀ jù láti inú àwọn ìwádìí tí àwọn aṣèwádìí mìíràn ṣe.
Zulu: Abacwaningi futhi abazange benze izivivinyo zabo ukuze bazise lezi zincomo; kunalokho, bazame ukuhlanganisa izindlela zokwelapha ezaziwa kakhulu ezifundweni ezenziwe abanye abacwaningi.
Hausa: Masu binciken kuma ba su gudanar da nasu gwaje-gwajen don sanar da waɗannan shawarwari ba; maimakon haka, sun yi ƙoƙarin tattara mafi kyawun zaɓin jiyya daga binciken da wasu masu bincike suka yi a baya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ga se ba dira le maitekelo a bona go thekga ditšhišinyo tše; eupša, ba lekile go kgoboketša dikgetho tša dikalafo tše di tumilego kudu go tšwa dinyakišišong tše di dirilwego ke banyakišiši ba bangwe.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እነዚህን ምክሮች ለማቅረብ የራሳቸውን ሙከራዎች አላደረጉም ይልቁንስ የሞከሩት በሌሎች ተመራማሪዎች ከተደረጉ ጥናቶች ውስጥ በጣም የታወቁ የህክምና አማራጮችን ለማቀናበር ነበር ።

English: These researchers, based in Nigeria and USA, therefore recommended more studies in different countries to test the success of the treatments recommended here.
Luganda: Noolwekyo, abanoonyereza bano, okuva mu Nigeria ne USA, baateesa wabeewo okunoonyereza okulala mu mawanga ag’enjawulo okugezesa enkola y’enzijanjaba eziteesebwa wano.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí yìí kalẹ̀ sí orílẹ̀-èdè Nigeria and USA, nítorí náà wọ́n dábàá àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí láti àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn láti lè ṣàyẹ̀wò àṣeyọrí àwọn ìtọ́jú tí wọ́n dábàá níbí.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi, abazinze eNigeria nase-USA, ngakho-ke bancome izifundo ezengeziwe emazweni ahlukene ukuze kuhlolwe impumelelo yokwelashwa okunconyiwe lapha.
Hausa: Waɗannan masu binciken, suna zaune ne a Nijeriya da Amurka, don haka, sun bayar da shawarar ƙarin nazari a ƙasashe daban-daban don gwada nasarar maganin da aka bayar da shawarar a nan.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba, bao ba tšwago go la Nigeria le USA, ka gona ba šišintše gore go dirwe dinyakišišo tše dingwe ka dinageng tše di fapafapanego go dira diteko tša katlego ya dikalafo tše di šišinywago mo.
Amharic: ስለዚህ በናይጄሪያ እና አሜሪካ የሚኖሩት እነዚህ ተመራማሪዎች እዚህ ላይ የቀረቡትን ህክምናዎች ስኬታማነት ለመፈተሽ ተጨማሪ ጥናቶች በተለያዩ ሃገሮች እንዲደረጉ መክረዋል።

English: They also encouraged doctors to consider other patient conditions during treatment.
Luganda: Era baasaba abasawo okulowooza ku mbeera z’abalwadde endala mu kubajjanjaba.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún gba àwọn dókítà níyànjú láti wo ipò àwọn aláìsàn mìíràn lásìkò ìtọ́jú.
Zulu: Baphinde bakhuthaza odokotela ukuthi bacabangele ezinye izimo zesiguli ngesikhathi sokwelashwa.
Hausa: Sun kuma ƙarfafa gwiwar likitocin da su yi la’akari da sauran yanayin marasa lafiya yayin jiyya.
Northern Sotho: Ba hlohleleditše le dingaka go lebelela maemo a mangwe a balwetši nakong ya kalafo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በህክምናው ወቅት ሌሎች የታካሚ ሁኔታዎችን ግምት ውስጥ እንዲያስገቡ ዶክተሮችን አበረታተዋል።
